snapshot.text: Public system rebuilt after the civil war and Ebola, still heavily donor-funded. The health budget was raised to US$110 million, and a new bilateral health agreement with the US has raised concerns about funding cuts and oversight.

priorities.title: Health partnership with the US
priorities.text: Liberia and the US are working on an implementation plan for a new health agreement.

priorities.title: Higher health budget
priorities.text: The health budget rose to US$110 million, with the finance minister pushing for stronger financing.
